facts.fact: Search-web results may not include a valid metadata.uri field, even when the source URL is present in the text.
The 'search-web' tool can return results that contain structured forecast data, but not all results will contain the specific information needed; verification by loading content is required.

tool_contracts.insight: The 'refine' tool returns a structured analysis of method syntax and semantics, but does not guarantee completeness or accuracy of the content; its output must be verified by loading and inspecting the resulting note.
The 'generate-note' tool produces a new, independent output based on a prompt and style, even when the input is a static note, and is suitable for creating original evaluations when required.

The tool returns a collection of results, but the relevance of individual results must be verified by loading and inspecting content; not all results contain structured forecast data, even when the query is specific.
The 'fetch-text' tool requires a direct string URL; it fails if given a Collection of Notes or a Note containing a URL string, even if the URL is valid.
The tool's effectiveness depends on a precise and unambiguous predicate; vague or structurally ambiguous patterns may result in no matches or incorrect filtering.
Can load content from search results to examine whether they contain the required forecast information; this is necessary to filter out irrelevant results.
Can create formatted notes but may truncate content when the input is very large; for large data sets, a more concise approach or multiple notes may be needed.
